install:
set -euo pipefail
touch "$HOME/.bashrc"
if ! grep -qxF '# >>> troupe-agent-env >>>' "$HOME/.bashrc"; then
  tmp_rc="$(mktemp)"
  {
    printf '%s\n' \
      '# >>> troupe-agent-env >>>' \
      'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' \
      'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' \
      'export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only' \
      '# <<< troupe-agent-env <<<'
    cat "$HOME/.bashrc"
  } > "$tmp_rc"
  cat "$tmp_rc" > "$HOME/.bashrc"
  rm -f "$tmp_rc"
fi
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pkgs=(ca-certificates curl libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libdbus-1-dev patchelf libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers libxkbcommon-x11-0 xvfb)
  missing=0
  for pkg in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
    dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'install ok installed' || { missing=1; break; }
  done
  if [ "$missing" -eq 1 ]; then
    sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y
    sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${pkgs[@]}"
  fi
fi
bun_ver="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"bun@\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' package.json)"
[ -n "$bun_ver" ] || { echo "Missing bun packageManager in package.json" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$HOME/.bun/bin"
if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ] && { [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] || [ "$("$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$bun_ver" ]; }; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) bun_plat="linux-x64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) bun_plat="linux-aarch64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported arch: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "${bun_ver}:${bun_plat}" in
    1.3.1:linux-x64) bun_sha256="52cf052a4e134d36b0c1667a4161e9abd1ba6692b67b576a6ac50300f61e606f" ;;
    1.3.1:linux-aarch64) bun_sha256="3a4e2fad254dc2c934084e4a1a8e2184116573f6a65bfba4a4c5a8586ae69112" ;;
    *) echo "No pinned SHA-256 for bun@${bun_ver} on ${bun_plat}; update .agents/environment.json" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT
  curl -fsSL "https://registry.npmjs.org/@oven/bun-${bun_plat}/-/bun-${bun_plat}-${bun_ver}.tgz" -o "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$bun_sha256" "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
  tar -xzf "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz" -C "$tmp_dir" package/bin/bun
  install -m 0755 "$tmp_dir/package/bin/bun" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"
  ln -sfn bun "$HOME/.bun/bin/bunx"
  rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
  trap - EXIT
fi
rustup target list --installed | grep -qx 'wasm32-unknown-unknown' || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
rustup toolchain list | grep -q '^1\.99\.1-' || rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal
rustup component list --installed --toolchain 1.99.1 | grep -q '^clippy-' || rustup component add clippy --toolchain 1.99.1
rustup component list --installed --toolchain 1.99.1 | grep -q '^rustfmt-' || rustup component add rustfmt --toolchain 1.99.1
rustup target list --installed --toolchain 1.99.1 | grep -qx 'wasm32-unknown-unknown' || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown --toolchain 1.99.1
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun -e "import { canaryBun } from './scripts/test.ts'; await canaryBun()"
bun scripts/canvas/check-figcraft-pin.mjs
bun scripts/canvas/fetch-figcraft-bundle.mjs
bun run build:web
test -s dist-web/index.html
cargo fetch --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
cargo fetch --manifest-path apps/rune/Cargo.toml
